method.description: Same five profiles, tactics and mirrored deployment on both sides. Each seed played twice with AI sides exchanged. Shared new resolution rules; support replanning enabled only for new AI. Historical AI modules loaded from Git snapshots. No career progression between matches.

statistics.method: Normal 95% interval using stratified variance across seed pairs; exact two-sided sign-flip permutation of version labels within pairs. Draw = half a point. Assumes exchangeability under the null and independent seed scenarios, not independent mirrored games.
